meta.source: loomit-slides plugin 2.0.0 (Calm Glass): scripts/loomit.js, scripts/post.py, assets/, fonts/

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Flat stand-in for the slide background images (bg-light-a/b on light, bg-dark on dark). Use the images on real slides; this is the colour under them and the ground every text note below is measured on.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Slide titles, card titles, big table values. 13:1 on light ground; 11:1 white on the dark ground.

tokens.name: fg-2
tokens.usage: Subtitles, body and captions (7.9:1 on light; 9:1+ on dark).

tokens.name: fg-3
tokens.usage: Labels, page numbers, table headers, the SAMPLE DATA tag (4.9:1 on light; 6:1+ on dark).

tokens.name: eyebrow
tokens.usage: The mono uppercase eyebrow above every title: eyebrow teal on light (5.8:1), mint on dark.

tokens.name: number
tokens.usage: Hero numbers: brand teal on light, lime on dark (lime is the one key number of a dark slide).

tokens.name: takeaway
tokens.usage: The one-line takeaway under the content (Medium 14).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on light; text on lime and mint fills; the dark end of brand gradients.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on light (body, subtitles).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text on light: labels, page numbers, table headers (4.9:1 on paper, 5.2:1 on white glass).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Brand teal: hero numbers, takeaways, the highlighted bar, the teal logo. 9.3:1 on paper.

tokens.name: eyebrow-teal
tokens.usage: Eyebrows on light slides (5.8:1 on paper).

tokens.name: chart-blue
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (test / optimized line), timeline progress, done steps.

tokens.name: chart-olive
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 in share bars. Fill only, never text.

tokens.name: chart-cobalt
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 in share bars. Fill only.

tokens.name: chart-grey
tokens.usage: Control series in line charts (drawn dashed).

tokens.name: bar-grey
tokens.usage: Every bar but the top one in a ranking.

tokens.name: axis-grey
tokens.usage: Timeline track, divider line next to the hero number.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Chart value gridlines.

tokens.name: hair
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows in tables and stat lists.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Light neutral (PowerPoint theme lt2).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Titles on dark slides; glass card fill.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Accent on dark only: eyebrows, the 36×2 rule, highlighted words in statements, the before/after arrow, the logo. Never text on a light ground.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Accent on dark only: the one key number per dark slide, the closing CTA line, the TEST START pill (with ink text, 10.8:1).

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Body text on dark slides and brand cards (8.4:1 on brand).

tokens.name: on-dark-2
tokens.usage: Labels and page numbers on dark slides (8:1 on ink). On the brand card's lighter top it is 4.4:1: keep it to the mono labels there.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Positive delta text, on positive-bg (4.8:1).

tokens.name: positive-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of positive pills.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Negative delta text. On negative-bg it reaches 4.3:1 (the source's own pair, just under 4.5): fine for the short mono pill, never for body text. 5:1 on white.

tokens.name: negative-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of negative pills.

tokens.name: brand-hi
tokens.usage: Light end of the brand card and the teal side panel gradients.

tokens.name: panel-lo
tokens.usage: Dark end of the teal side panel gradient.

tokens.name: brand-pill
tokens.usage: Pill fill inside a brand card (mint text, 5.5:1).

tokens.name: start-line
tokens.usage: Dashed TEST START marker line in line charts.

tokens.name: dot-strong
tokens.usage: Status dot for Optimizing (with a soft ring).

tokens.name: dot-on
tokens.usage: Status dot for Active / Running / Live.

tokens.name: dot-off
tokens.usage: Status dot for paused or incomplete.

tokens.name: glass-edge-top
tokens.usage: Top of the glass card's 1px edge gradient.

tokens.name: glass-edge-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom of the glass card's 1px edge gradient.

tokens.name: rec-edge
tokens.usage: Dotted edge of the screen-recording placeholder.

tokens.name: dark-top
tokens.usage: Lightest corner of the dark slide background (top left).

tokens.name: dark-bottom
tokens.usage: Darkest corner of the dark slide background (bottom right).

styles.name: title-cover
styles.usage: Cover title, white on dark. Black 900, shrinks to fit one line.

styles.name: title-closing
styles.usage: Closing slide title.

styles.name: title-statement
styles.sample: From one setup per app to twelve tuned segments per app.
styles.usage: Statement / section slide; a few words may be mint. About 70 characters max.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Revenue grew while ad time went down
styles.usage: Every content slide title: one line, about 50 characters. Never swap Black for a lighter weight.

styles.name: title-split
styles.sample: Knowing what to try next is the hard part
styles.usage: Title on the right of the split-panel slide (may take two lines).

styles.name: number-hero
styles.usage: The one huge result on the hero-number slide (unit at 96px). Brand teal.

styles.name: number-xl
styles.usage: Mint number on the teal split panel.

styles.name: number-kpi
styles.usage: Lime hero value in the dark KPI trio.

styles.name: number-ba
styles.usage: Before / after values.

styles.name: number-lg
styles.usage: Secondary KPIs on dark, side stats (60), callout value (56).

styles.name: number-md
styles.usage: KPI card values, hero-number stats (44), split-panel rows (40).

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Big numbers, cards, charts and tables for client decks.
styles.usage: Cover, statement and closing subtitle; also the split-panel caption.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.sample: The backlog is not the problem. Getting through it is.
styles.usage: One line under a content title.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card titles (≤35 characters), KPI card names (15), table app names (14).

styles.name: takeaway
styles.sample: Run in house, a single change can take months.
styles.usage: The one-line takeaway, brand teal on light.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Still in the backlog after two quarters.
styles.usage: Card body (≤90 characters), captions (14–15).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Eyebrow above every title. Uppercase, eyebrow colour.

styles.name: table-number
styles.usage: Numbers in table cells, right aligned, ink.

styles.name: pill
styles.usage: Pills and page numbers ('04 / 13').

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels in cards, table headers, chart axes. Uppercase.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: The SAMPLE DATA tag and KPI-card notes. Uppercase.

tokens.name: canvas-w
tokens.usage: Slide width. 1px here = 1pt in PowerPoint (13.333 in wide slide).

tokens.name: canvas-h
tokens.usage: Slide height (7.5 in).

tokens.name: margin
tokens.usage: Left margin (0.889 in) — eyebrows, titles, logo, content all start here.

tokens.name: margin-right
tokens.usage: Right margin (content ends at 12.546 in = 903.3px).

tokens.name: content-w
tokens.usage: Content width between the margins.

tokens.name: eyebrow-y
tokens.usage: Eyebrow top on content slides.

tokens.name: title-y
tokens.usage: Title top on content slides (1.28 in).

tokens.name: subtitle-y
tokens.usage: Subtitle top (2.02 in).

tokens.name: content-y
tokens.usage: Content starts here (2.2 in); 212px when there is a subtitle.

tokens.name: content-bottom
tokens.usage: Nothing below this line (6.25 in) except logo, page number and the sample tag.

tokens.name: footer-y
tokens.usage: Footer logo top (6.875 in); page number at 491px.

tokens.name: gap
tokens.usage: Gap between cards (0.23 in).

tokens.name: card-pad
tokens.usage: Padding inside cards (0.3 in).

tokens.name: rule-w
tokens.usage: Mint rule under dark titles (0.5 in).

tokens.name: rule-h
tokens.usage: Mint rule height.

tokens.name: pill-h
tokens.usage: Pill height (0.3 in).

tokens.name: logo-w
tokens.usage: Footer logo width (0.833 in); 16px tall.

tokens.name: logo-cover-w
tokens.usage: Cover logo width (1.389 in), top-left at y 52px; 27px tall.

tokens.name: split-panel-w
tokens.usage: Width of the teal panel on the split-panel slide (5.2 in).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Every card: glass, brand, dark glass, dark hero, recording placeholder.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Small glass chips.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, share bars, dots.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: White glass card on light: inner top highlight plus a soft teal shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-chip
tokens.usage: Glass chip.

tokens.name: shadow-brand
tokens.usage: Brand (teal) highlight card.

tokens.name: shadow-darkglass
tokens.usage: Translucent card on a dark slide.

tokens.name: shadow-darkhero
tokens.usage: Mint-tinted hero card on a dark slide.

tokens.name: gradient-glass
tokens.usage: Glass card fill.

tokens.name: gradient-edge-glass
tokens.usage: Glass card 1px edge.

tokens.name: gradient-brand
tokens.usage: Brand highlight card fill (one per slide).

tokens.name: gradient-edge-brand
tokens.usage: Brand card edge.

tokens.name: gradient-darkglass
tokens.usage: Dark glass card fill.

tokens.name: gradient-edge-darkglass
tokens.usage: Dark glass card edge.

tokens.name: gradient-darkhero
tokens.usage: Dark hero card fill (mint tint).

tokens.name: gradient-edge-darkhero
tokens.usage: Dark hero card edge.

tokens.name: gradient-rec
tokens.usage: Screen-recording placeholder fill (dotted rec-edge border).

tokens.name: gradient-panel
tokens.usage: Full-height teal panel of the split-panel slide.

tokens.name: gradient-dark-slide
tokens.usage: Fallback for the bg-dark image where images can't be used.
